title: pinalia curranii
intro: Pinalia curranii, commonly known as the 'Queen of Malaya' or 'Malaysian Queen Orchid', is a species of orchid. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, and is traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pinalia curranii include its ability to calm the nervous system and reduce anxiety, as well as its antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
